title: Loombridge Platformer Feel Profile
description: PRODUCT-OWNED. A named set of MEASURABLE 2D-platformer feel target bands (precision / classic / momentum). The verify-first counterpart to a game's AcceptanceContract.feel section: a profile says what band a healthy metric sits in for a *family* of platformer feels, so `loombridge verify` can report measured-vs-band per metric without a prior plan/build. The runtime source of truth is `mcp-server/src/capabilities/genre/genre-packs/platformer-2d/validator.ts`; this JSON Schema documents the same contract. Key rule: every metric MUST define a tolerance band — an exact (band-less) target is refused, because feel is measured behaviorally and never lands on an exact value.

id.description: Stable profile id (lowercase kebab, starts with a letter), e.g. 'precision'.

exemplars.description: Optional example games that exemplify this feel (prose, not enforced).

metrics.description: Measurable target bands keyed by a known platformer metric id. Must be non-empty (a profile with no measurable metrics is refused). Property names are constrained to the KNOWN_PROFILE_METRICS vocabulary. Each metric carries a gating class in that vocabulary: 'grammar' metrics gate pass/fail in every mode, 'taste' metrics are descriptive placement unless the run opts in with --enforce-taste, and 'measure-only' metrics may never be banded (runtime refusal BANDED_MEASURE_ONLY; this enum already excludes them structurally).

build.description: F2 build-side identity: the starting params the band targets cannot analytically derive. OPTIONAL (absent on a verify-only profile). NOTE: the cross-field rules (a build block requires the jumpApex/timeToApex/runSpeed solve bands — BUILD_SOLVE_MISSING_BAND; a stored jumpCutMultiplier requires a shortHopApex band — BUILD_PARAM_UNVERIFIABLE) are enforced at RUNTIME by validator.ts, not by this schema.

fixedTimestep.description: The physics timestep the solve + discretization correction assume (e.g. 0.0166667).

stored.description: Un-solvable starting params. Today only jumpCutMultiplier; empty for a profile (e.g. momentum) that bands no shortHopApex.

jumpCutMultiplier.description: Jump-cut multiplier on early button release. NOT solvable from a band; storable only when shortHopApex is banded.

mechanisms.description: F3 mechanism identity: which movement CAPABILITIES this feel requires/forbids, verified BEHAVIORALLY by the `mechanisms` gate (a captured-trajectory signature, never a controller self-report). OPTIONAL (absent = no mechanism claim). Both lists draw from the closed KNOWN_MECHANISMS vocabulary; an entry outside it is refused (UNKNOWN_MECHANISM) and an id in both lists is refused (CONTRADICTORY_MECHANISM) — enforced at RUNTIME by validator.ts. An empty block (requires: [], forbids: []) is valid and claims nothing.

requires.description: Mechanisms whose behavioral signature MUST be present.

forbids.description: Mechanisms whose behavioral signature MUST be absent.

mechanismId.description: A known movement mechanism (each has a defined behavioral probe). wallSlide/wallJump are deliberately out (deferred).

toleranceBand.title: Tolerance band
toleranceBand.description: Exactly one of `percent` or `abs`. Required on every profile metric. Defining both is refused (AMBIGUOUS_BAND) — otherwise the accepted window would depend on the comparison helper's precedence (bandWindow prefers abs), not the contract.

abs.description: Symmetric absolute band in the metric's unit.

metricTarget.title: Profile metric target
metricTarget.description: A measurable target band. Reuses the verification NumericTarget shape but REQUIRES `band`. NOTE: this schema validates `unit` only against the GLOBAL unit enum; the per-metric canonical unit (e.g. runSpeed must be u/s — WRONG_UNIT) is enforced at RUNTIME by validator.ts/KNOWN_PROFILE_METRICS, which is the source of truth. A schema-only consumer therefore would NOT reject runSpeed in ms; use the runtime validator to fully validate.

target.description: The center of the healthy band.

unit.description: Measurement unit. Must be a globally supported unit here; the canonical-unit-per-metric rule is enforced at runtime (validator.ts), not by this enum.

whyItMatters.description: One-sentence rationale for the developer report.

suggestion.description: Concrete parameter advice when a measurement falls outside the band.
